page.overview:
Who is Conis?

Conis is a citizen of Skypiea who befriended Monkey D. Luffy and his crew after their arrival. She is Pagaya's daughter and owner of a cloud fox named Su.

Conis is a relatively tall, slender young woman with blonde hair that she wears in two braided pig-tails and two antennae sticking out at the top of her head.

Conis wears a pink dress with red, flower shaped textures that goes to her thighs. She also wears red and pink striped sandals, that are white on the bottom.

After the time skip, she wears bangs. She also wears a dark colored sleeveless shirt with two white vertical stripes and a picture of a winged pumpkin.
